name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2134: The item card footer set its visibility as an inline style, and an inline declaration outranks every stylesheet rule, so the prose lane hide for that footer was present and correct and could never apply. A footer left from the last card stayed visible when the prose lane took over the shared tooltip, printing the same sentence twice. Visibility is a class now so the cascade decides, with no important anywhere. Also the accordion spec called the toggle function directly and never pressed the header he actually presses, so removing that wiring would have left it green.
